svg.title: One decode step at 12 games: 27.8 ms
svg.desc: GPU profile of the 8-bit build on 7 Oct. The experts are more than half the step. At 31 games the step was 41.6 ms, with the experts at 18.0 ms: already at the weight-read floor.
